text:
`~/.config/nutsack/config.toml` (or `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nutsack/config.toml`), TOML, `0600`:
```toml
nsec = "nsec1..."
relays = ["wss://...", ...]
mints = ["https://...", ...]
```
`NUTSACK_NSEC` env var still bypasses onboarding AND this file entirely (dev/power-user override — never persisted, never echoed back, since the caller already has it).
